name: Cursor
mood: Warm parchment developer atelier with weight-400 headings, compact 4px geometry, paper-like product cards, developer monospace details, and ember text accents.

bone.role: Product cards, mockup frames, and elevated paper surfaces.

linen.role: Secondary button fill, logo tiles, and higher paper surfaces.

mist.role: Captions, helper text, and tertiary UI copy.

driftwood.role: Secondary body text and quieter table copy.

ash.role: Icon fills, metadata, and subdued labels.

ink.role: Primary text, nav text, primary action fill, and core UI chrome.

ember.role: Inline links, tags, and short text emphasis only.

amber.role: Small in-product action buttons and accent icon strokes.

forest.role: Focused product actions and selected states.

fallbacks.editorial: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, ui-serif, Georgia, serif
fallbacks.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

rules: Use CursorGothic-style type for almost all UI, navigation, headings, and body text.
Set display headings at weight 400; do not use 600 or 700 for large headings.
Tighten letter spacing as type size increases.
Use EB Garamond only for editorial prose and subheadings.
Use berkeleyMono at 12px or 13px for code, file paths, tabs, and metadata.

components.name: Primary Filled Button
components.recipe: Ink fill, Parchment text, 4px radius, compact padding, CursorGothic 14px/400.

components.name: Secondary Filled Button
components.recipe: Linen fill, Ink text, 4px radius, compact padding, visually lighter than the primary.

components.name: Ghost Text Button
components.recipe: Transparent background, muted Ink text, 4px focus radius, no border, underline on hover.

components.name: Amber Action Button
components.recipe: Amber fill, light cream text, 4px radius, compact product-UI sizing.

components.name: Forest Action Button
components.recipe: Forest fill, Parchment text, same-color border, 4px radius, used for selected product actions.

components.name: Product Mockup Card
components.recipe: Bone surface, 4px radius, warm hairline border, 24px padding, soft warm paper shadow.

components.name: Logo Trust Tile
components.recipe: Linen tile with monochrome Ink logo at reduced opacity.

components.name: Window Mockup Frame
components.recipe: macOS-style chrome, muted control dots, centered title, small file tabs, and berkeleyMono labels.

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.recipe: Transparent 52px header with logo left, compact center links, and action cluster on the right.

components.name: Terminal Input Field
components.recipe: Transparent or Bone background, hairline Ink-tinted border, 4px radius, berkeleyMono 12px.

components.name: Footer Link Column
components.recipe: No card; CursorGothic heading and compact muted link list directly on canvas.

components.name: Mono Metadata Tag
components.recipe: Transparent background, berkeleyMono 12px Ash text, no border, no radius.

do: Use Parchment canvas and Bone cards.
Use 4px radius for cards, buttons, inputs, and tiles.
Use Ember only for inline text emphasis.
Use warm hairline borders before adding shadows.
Use product screenshots and IDE windows as primary imagery.
dont: Do not use pure white or pure black as foundations.
Do not use pill buttons or rounded cards.
Do not use gradients, glows, or color washes.
Do not make shadows blue or glassy.
Do not use Ember as a background fill.
